title: garcinia cambogia var. zeylanica
intro: Garcinia cambogia var. zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon Garcinia, is a plant species in the family Clusiaceae, native to Sri Lanka. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including aiding in weight management and reducing cholesterol levels, due to its ability to suppress appetite and enhance metabolism. The therapeutic actions of Ceylon Garcinia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and xanthone derivatives, such as garcinol and isogarcinol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
